transcript_segments.text: I keep one face toward the light calculated always right
The title pull has locked me still held in place against my will
Measured glow careful show surface calm but never slow
Every motion predefined to a line with watching eyes
They map me like a satellite trace my edges chart my night
What they see is only one half truth beneath the sun I rotate without turning inside
The other side
Gravity writes through my spine equations etched in borrowed time
You're what they need to find predictable precise lines
Spectral lines they think they read don't reveal what I can see
It all their models fall apart near the margins of my chart
They send their probes they call it care skimming through my outer air
Collecting fragments fleeting data never reaching what comes later
Peripary abscess too close to why the other side
For a bit hiding's pressure climbs face shifts the pain out of time
Every input overlay no subtraction nothing things
So learn wins against my skin too much signal flooding in
I fracture at the seams they trust composition turns the best
They attempt to close a pass but trajectories don't last
He even distance into fear nothing stable can draw near a burning arc
A failed glide the other side
Too bright too much too near
All of it there's collapse at once no stable frame to hold response
I break the lock but not by choice distortion tearing through my voice days
Even the flare they turn away no instrument be prepared to stay
Just a flash of data spike miss interpreted as I know nothing here no place to buy
The other side
Now I drift but still I'm bound no full rotation never found one face
No one always missed a constant half that can't exist no right papers
The speculator proximate but never stayed what remains beyond their sight
Is not absence just no light I am a whole but split by design
A hidden half that won't align no more that breaks no past collide
The other side
